bio: You can enjoy the more casual concept of Atrio’s cuisine in this restaurant occupying a 15C mansion located in the heart of the town’s old quarter, just a few metres from its famous three-Michelin-star sibling. In this informal setting, savour dishes with a more traditional and regional flavour, including Iberian sausage, local cheeses, delicious stews, grilled meats, a few fusion-inspired dishes as well as enticing desserts. In fine weather, it’s well worth booking a table on the attractive terrace....
